source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Locate the part number for the 2-way valve.
3. Duplicate the information on the inspection report, but change the pass to fail status on the second page of the inspection report.
4. Save the document as an image file and upload it to the system.
5. Submit the report for review and approval.

## Guidance
The safety audit was performed on the industrial valve - a 2-way type with pneumatic actuation. The failed industrial safety audit report will be used to track and assess the safety performance of the valve. The failure in the report should be documented in detail, including the root cause of the failure, the corrective actions taken to address the failure, and the preventive measures to prevent future failures. The report should contain all the relevant information so that corrective actions can be effectively implemented to rectify the issues identified during the safety audit.<eos>
